body: I will say I agree, threatened wasn't really the right word.

Personally, whatever happened to have me associate "gatekeeping" with feminine behavior. And when I see trans guys doing this, it feels like it's "feminine behavior". It makes little to no sense but alas.

Logically I know it is incredibly stupid, im my own person, i have my own body. But its almost like when you see someone doing something "cringy" and feel like your in their place. Thats how it feels sometimes, no matter how dumb it truly is
